description: Functional specification/files: Channel-local attachment preparation module plus existing Zaq.Materialization and Record contracts. Supply lazy acquisition/materialization and file validation primitives that future executor can invoke; do not acquire content while constructing metadata plans. Reuse current signed handle and provenance/authorization contracts, never raw source retrieval. Validate actual content and known size/metadata limits at acquisition, preserve optional unresolved facts. No executor orchestration, provider upload/send/edit, exact SMTP MIME encoding, failure-policy execution or outcomes in PR4. Those belong to PR5. Tests before implementation/paths: metadata planning causes no IO; explicit acquisition redeems authorized handles through existing boundary; invalid handles/content/name/MIME and actual-size drift; preserve nil-identity security; no provider sends. Mock only external IO, keep internal materialization real and runtime configuration isolated. Action reuse: reuse Zaq.Materialization and Record contracts, local-only preparation helpers; no new tool or Action. Consumers: PR5 Channel executor; records/plan remain immutable and bytes transient. Docs: Channel service and module contracts. Follow workflow/testing policies, with explicit approval for existing test behavior changes. Planning only.

comments.text: Implementation plan: Preparation.acquire(record, requirements, trusted_context \\ %{}) lazily redeems signed handles via Zaq.Materialization and validates resulting file metadata/content plus actual byte size. Shared metadata/size validators remain in Delivery.Attachments; decoding reuses validated DecodeBase64 Action with standard alphabet only. TrustedContext projection preserves explicit actor/skip_permissions only plus local router/config dependencies; nil actor is never bypass. Return transient content map, leave source/plan unchanged. validate_group checks actual fixed-group count/byte lower bounds without regrouping; no request encoding, orchestration or provider operations. Tests before code: direct binary/base64, malformed metadata/encoding/content/handles, actual size drift, authorized CommunicationMedia redemption with real handle verification and Mox only at routed external I/O, nil actor and canonical read denial, original indices/fixed grouping. Document channels.md and module contracts; no existing assertion changes.

title: [zaq-6rc.4] PR4 lazy acquisition and attachment validation primitives
